classification.difficultyReason: Combine half a circumference with the diameter, retaining an exact answer or using the specified approximation for pi.

content.prompt: The perimeter of a semicircle is the distance around the semicircle (which includes the diameter).

children.label: a
children.prompt:
What is the perimeter of a semicircle with radius $35\text{ cm}$?

Leave your answer in terms of $\pi$. (The dot indicates the centre of the full circle.)

spec.description: Upper semicircle closed by its horizontal diameter; centre dot at the midpoint; 35 cm beneath the right-hand radius. Decorative blue outline and red centre marker are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The labelled half of the diameter is a radius of 35 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Given figure only; no answer supplied.

answer.worked:
The curved edge is half the circumference; include the diameter.

$$\begin{align*}P&=\frac12(2\pi r)+2r\\P&=\pi\times35+2\times35\\P&=(70+35\pi)\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the approximate value of the perimeter of a semicircle with radius $42\text{ cm}$ if we use $\pi\approx\frac{22}{7}$?

spec.description: Upper semicircle closed by its horizontal diameter; centre dot at the midpoint; 42 cm beneath the right-hand radius. Decorative source colours are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: The labelled half of the diameter is a radius of 42 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Given figure only; no answer supplied.

answer.worked:
Add half the circumference and the diameter, using the specified approximation for $\pi$.

$$\begin{align*}P&=\frac12(2\pi r)+2r\\P&=42\pi+84\\P&\approx42\times\frac{22}{7}+84\\P&\approx216\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
